project.name: Enterprise-Support-Agent
project.objective: Build the Enterprise AI Customer Support Agent as designed in docs/: the orchestration core and all 15 components, implementing the 79 ADPs in docs/decisions/adp/.

plan_approval.reason: Genesis plan has been updated accordingly.

approval.reason: Have updated the SPEC.md with all the free tier tools and services.

decisions.title: Cloud platform: AWS
decisions.text: The system runs on AWS (EKS, KMS, Secrets Manager, S3, RDS Postgres) in US and EU regions; Cedar authorization fits AWS natively. Chosen by the human during SPEC-1 discovery.

decisions.title: LLM provider: Anthropic Claude for mid and frontier tiers
decisions.text: Mid-tier and frontier tiers (CR-D1) use Anthropic Claude models; the third tier is the self-hosted open-weights model per region (RP-D4). The EV judge must come from a different model family (EV-Q3).

decisions.title: Delivery: ordered milestones
decisions.text: All 15 components plus orchestration are in scope; delivery is in ordered milestones, each a set of bounded tasks, defined in the plan.

decisions.title: Success for first production release: launch baseline
decisions.text: No numeric business targets at launch. Success = the EV-D5 release gate passes and the 8 framework scenarios pass end to end; business targets (deflection, CSAT, FCR) are set after one month of production data.

decisions.title: v1 runtime: learning deployment profile (one free VM + free managed services)
decisions.text: This is a learning project, not sold to businesses. The 79 ADPs remain the target design (AWS, US/EU regions, Kubernetes, GPUs). v1 runs on one Oracle Cloud Always Free ARM VM (Docker Compose: Temporal dev server + workers, orchestrator, API, Qdrant or Qdrant Cloud, Jaeger, OpenBao, Ollama) plus free managed services (Vercel frontend, Neon/Supabase Postgres, Qdrant Cloud, Cloudflare R2, Upstash Redis, Grafana Cloud/Langfuse, Hugging Face Spaces for the Streamlit console, GitHub Actions). LLMs: Claude mid/frontier under a hard spend cap, Groq/Gemini free tiers and Ollama for the third tier, judge and screening. Total monthly spend cap: USD 50 (provider spend limits). Every requirement is satisfied in its v1 form per the SPEC.md profile table.
decisions.source: user choice 2026-10-09; cost analysis in session

decisions.title: v1 runtime: learning deployment profile, USD 10/month cap
decisions.text: Same learning deployment profile as DECISION-b4cdefcc (one Oracle Cloud Always Free ARM VM with Docker Compose + free managed services; the 79 ADPs remain the production target), with the total monthly spend cap lowered from USD 50 to USD 10 by the human. Free tiers (Groq / Gemini, or Ollama) serve easy and mid-difficulty turns, the fallback, judge and screening; Claude serves only the hardest turns under a USD 10 console spend limit, falling back to the best free model when the limit is reached.

knowledge.title: Design source of truth
knowledge.text: Binding design lives in docs/decisions/checkpoint.md (decision log §3, reasoning per component), docs/decisions/adp_groups.yaml (230 decisions grouped into 79 ADPs) and one detailed document per ADP in docs/decisions/adp/. SPEC.md requirements map one-to-one to ADPs.

knowledge.title: Run gates with the project venv on PATH
knowledge.text: On this machine 'python' on PATH resolves to another tool's venv (hermes-agent) without pytest. The project venv is .venv (Python 3.12, pip install -e .[dev]); run Genesis gates as PATH="$PWD/.venv/Scripts:$PATH" genesis gate . <task>. Never install project deps into the hermes venv.
